source: NOAA GHCN-Daily (daily TMAX/TMIN; values with a quality flag skipped). Public domain, cite NOAA NCEI.
method: hi99: 99th percentile of daily highs (99% of days have a high below it); lo1: 1st percentile of daily lows (99% of nights have a low above it); linear interpolation; °C rounded to 0.1. A station qualifies with TMAX and TMIN on at least 60% of days and on at least 50% of the days of every calendar month. Stations listed are the nearest qualifying station within 50 km of a ClimaClue town (up to 6 nearest tried, skipping stations whose archive years cannot cover 60% of the period). n_tmax/n_tmin: days used; years: years with 300+ days (lower of the two); name, x (lon), y (lat), z (m) from the station list.
